Reference / digest/read

digest/read#

Digests of byte streams.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let digest = ReadDigest(file.reading(), Sha256()).result();

Description#

Digests of byte streams. ReadDigest consumes a borrowed synchronous Reading until its empty end-of-stream chunk and returns the successor of the given digest over everything read; AsyncReadDigest does the same over AsyncReading. The chunk size bounds each read (default 65536; non-positive sizes are InvalidArgument at construction). Construction reads nothing; result() reads the stream once per call, so a second call continues from where the source is. Neither object closes the source. Source errors propagate unchanged.
